g.text: QA request flow with the SetFit router (proposal, ADR-012)
The classifier replaces the embedding comparison of the semantic router; rules stay first; five corpus-dependent labels are left to retrieval
rules decide, no LLM, no retrieval
Deferred labels travel with the question
Legend: blue rules | green local model or retrieval | orange LLM or GPU job | yellow decision or note | red early exit (dashed) | teal storage
